items.title: 동국제강, 비수기·보수에도 3Q 별도 영업익 244억 '선방' 전망

items.title: GS25, 김밥 매출 36.2% 증가…"차별화 상품으로 수요 늘어"

items.title: 외국계 IB가 본 韓증시…외국인 매도 '디리스킹' 전환
items.snippet: 최근 코스피 급락을 바라보는 해외 금융기관들의 시선이 심상치 않다.지난 7월 외국인의 대규모 매도가 레버리지 축소와 포지션 정리 성격이었다면, 최근에는 위험자산 자체를 줄이는 '디리스킹(De-risking)'으로 매도의 성격이 바뀌었다는 진단이 나왔다.인공지능(AI) 산업의 자금조달 불안과 중국발 메모리 경쟁 심화에 국내 증시의 수급 여건 약화까지 맞물리면서 변동성을 키우고 있다는 평가다.16일 국제금융센터가 취합한 주요 해외 금융기관 시각에 따르면 모건스탠리는 최근 외국인의 국내 주식 매도세를 본격적인 위험자산 축소 흐름으로 평

items.title: 증시 대폭락에 애널들도 공황…"이렇게 밀릴 줄은 몰랐다"
items.snippet: "바닥이 가늠이 안 되는데… 뭐라고 단정할 자신이 없네요."낙폭이 과도하다며 반발 매수를 기대했던 증권가가 지난 15일 '검은 목요일'을 겪고선 말문이 막혔다. 저가 매수를 권했던 증권사 애널리스트들도 하루 만에 신중론으로 정정했다. 낙폭은 과도하지만 상황을 반전시킬 재료가 안 보인단 것이다.16일 연합인포맥스 '금융시장종합'(화면번호 3000)에 따르면 전날 코스피는 7.57% 급락한 5,554.22에 거래를 끝냈다.올해 4월 7일(5,494.78) 이후 최저치인데, 지수는 7거래일 만에 '7천피'에서 '5천피'로 주저앉았다.

items.title: 청해부대 임무 오만만까지 확대 추진
items.snippet: 정부가 올해 말 임무가 종료되는 청해부대의 파견을 연장하면서 임무 범위를 확대하는 방안을 추진 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 정부는 호르무즈 해협 파병과는 선을 긋고 있지만, 청해부대 임무 강화가 이재명 대통령이 언급해 온 ‘호르무즈 기여’ 방안이 될 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 국방부는 15일 “최근 소말리아 아덴만 해역의 해적 활동이 예년 대비 급증하는 등 해당 지역의 안전 상황이 악화되고 있다”며 “청해부대 파견 동의안의 만료 이전, 연장 동의안 제출을 준비 중”이라고 밝혔다. 강신철 국방부 장관도 이날 국회 법제사법위원회의 국정감사에서 “청해부대의 임무, 파견 연장에 대한 부분들은 여러 가지로 다양하게 검토하고 있다”고 말했다. 일각에선 동의안에 아덴만 해역을 기본으로 하는 작전 범위를 호르무즈 해협 인근 오만만으로 넓히는 방안도 거론된다. 다...

items.title: 민주-국힘 지지율 오차범위내… 李정부 출범후 처음
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 지지율이 33%, 국민의힘이 28%로 집계되면서 양당 지지율 격차가 이재명 정부 출범 이후 처음으로 오차범위 안으로 좁혀졌다. 엠브레인퍼블릭, 케이스탯리서치, 코리아리서치, 한국리서치가 12일부터 14일까지 전국 성인 남녀 1000명을 조사해 15일 발표한 10월 셋째 주 전국지표조사(NBS, 무선전화 면접 100%, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 민주당 지지율은 33%, 국민의힘은 28%로 조사됐다. 직전 조사(10월 첫째 주)에선 민주당 35%, 국민의힘 25%였다. items.title: 양향자 “전면 재선거” 장동혁 “흔드니 좋나”… 국힘 최고위원회 충돌
items.snippet: 국민의힘 경기 용인갑 조직위원장 선거 과정에서 자동응답(ARS) 전화가 일부 당원들에게 발신되지 않은 것과 관련해 당 지도부와 당사자인 양향자 최고위원이 공개석상에서 충돌했다. 비당권파인 양 최고위원이 “‘올공(올림픽공원) 원칙’을 대입해 전체 선거에 대한 전수조사와 전면 재선거가 필요하다”고 주장하자 당권파가 “당 시스템을 무너뜨리고 있다”며 설전을 벌인 것. 경기 용인갑 경선에서 패배한 양 최고위원은 15일 최고위에서 “ARS 경선에서는 전화 오는 절차가 곧 투표용지인데, ARS 전화가 오지 않았다는 (당원들의) 제보가 지금도 오고 있다”고 했다. 그러자 정희용 사무총장은 “당의 시스템을 무력화하는 발언”이라며 공개적으로 항의했다. 이어진 비공개 최고위에서도 장동혁 대표는 “부정선거로 싸우고 있는 당 대표까지 싸울 자격을 없게 만들고 당...

items.title: “수공, 尹정부때 외교부 협의 않고 우크라 재건 추진”
items.snippet: 한국수자원공사가 윤석열 정부 시절 우크라이나 재건 사업을 외교당국과 협의하지 않고 일방적으로 추진한 것으로 나타났다. 당시 외교당국은 러시아와의 관계를 고려해 우크라이나에 대한 지원에 부정적이었다. 15일 김태선 더불어민주당 의원실이 기후에너지환경부에서 받은 수자원공사 특정감사 보고서에 따르면 수공은 2024년 2월 우크라이나 트루스카베츠에 식수 공급 시설을 지원하는 사업을 외교부와 협의하지 않고 진행했다. 국제개발협력기본법에 따르면 국제개발협력 사업을 추진하는 기관은 외교부를 통해 재외 공관과 협의해야 한다. 기후부는 지난해 말 수공에 대한 감사에 착수해 올 2월 보고서를 내놨다. 윤 전 대통령은 2023년 7월 폴란드에서 열린 ‘우크라이나 재건 협력 기업 간담회’에 참석해 민관 협력을 통한 재건사업 참여를 지원하겠다고 밝혔다. 같은 해 1...

items.title: 가게 직원과 시비, 옆집 문소리에… 흉기 든 ‘그놈들’
items.snippet: 13일 인천 남동구의 대형 상가에서 흉기 난동을 벌인 살인미수 전과자 최모 씨(59)는 정신 질환 치료 중 범행을 저질렀다. 공공장소에서 흉기를 들고 다니다 재판에 넘겨진 이들 중 상당수가 최 씨처럼 △분노 표출 △정신질환 △전과 등 위험 요소를 보인 것으로 나타났다. 특히 공공장소 흉기 소지가 자칫 이상동기 범죄로 이어질 가능성도 커 청와대가 15일 관계부처 합동 회의를 열고 대책 마련에 나섰다. 살인미수죄로 복역한 뒤 전자발찌를 차고 있던 최 씨는 지난달 병원 치료에 불만을 표하며 거리에서 흉기를 꺼내 이달 초 공공장소 흉기 소지 혐의로 입건됐다. 그는 알코올 중독 등 정신질환으로 치료받는 상태였다. 경찰은 위험성이 큰 흉기 소지자는 구속이나 입원 등 후속 조치를 하는데, 최 씨는 이 위험성 평가를 받지 않았다. 공공장소 흉기소지죄로 올해...

items.title: [단독]채무자 수수료로 年 수억 챙기는 ‘외부 회생위원들’
items.snippet: 재정 위기를 맞은 채무자의 개인회생을 돕기 위해 법원이 지정하는 변호사 등 ‘외부 회생위원’들이 채무자들의 수수료로 매년 수억 원의 고소득을 얻는 것으로 나타났다. 빚에 허덕이는 채무자들이 변제액의 일정 비율을 수수료로 추가로 납부하면서 외부 위원들의 배를 불리고 있다는 지적이 나온다. 외부 회생위원은 개인회생 신청이 급증하면서 법원 소속 공무원인 ‘내부 회생위원’만으로 채무조정 업무를 감당할 수 없어 2012년부터 도입된 제도지만 내부 회생위원은 수수료가 전혀 없는 만큼 형평성 논란이 제기된다. 여기에 법원마다 외부 위원 배정 기준도 제각각인 만큼 전면적인 제도 손질이 필요하다는 목소리가 커질 것으로 보인다.● 채무자 수수료로 연평균 수억 원 소득국회 법제사법위원회 소속 더불어민주당 김기표 의원실이 대법원으로부터 제출받은 자료에 따르면 지역...

items.title: [굿모닝 멤버십] 버핏도 매일 저녁 유튜브 본다
items.snippet: 굿모닝! 조선멤버십 회원님들 10월 16일 금요일 아침입니다. 오늘은 대한민국과 사우디아라비아가 공식 외교 관계를 수립한 지 64년이 되는 날입니다. 1962년 수교 당시만 해도 지도상 아득히 멀게만 느껴졌던 사막의 나라는, 1970년대 한국 기업들의 건설 시장 진출을 계기로 오늘날 한국의 핵심 경제 파트너로 자리 잡았죠. 최근에는 사우디의 탈석유 산업 다각화 계획인 ‘비전 2030’의 중점 협력국으로 한국이 선정되며 전통적인 에너지와 건설 인프라 협력을 넘어 AI와 방산, 문화 교류로 양국의 보폭을 크게 넓혀가고 있습니다. 먼 거리에도 불구하고 60여 년간 이어온 협력과 신뢰가 앞으로도 양국을 잇는 든든한 다리가 되길 기대합니다.

items.title: 아이 가르치던 수영 강사에서 치매 노인 웃게 하는 ‘희망이’ 선생님으로
items.snippet: 2024년 8월 경기 광명의 한 데이케어센터. 은윤경(56)씨가 처음으로 실버 운동 강사로 나섰다. 치매 노인들에게 가르친 종목은 농구였다. 수강생들은 의자에 앉아 공을 주고받고 낮은 골대에 던졌다. 은씨가 “우리는 할 수 있다”고 외치자 노인들도 따라 외쳤다. 30여 년 전 어린이 수영 강사로 일할 때 쓰던 구호였다. 당시 수강생은 5~7세 아이들이었다.

items.title: 오페라 제대로 즐기려면… 보이는 만큼 들린다! ‘Surtitles’

items.title: 경찰에 8번 신고했는데… 또 막지 못한 죽음
items.snippet: 지난 13일 전북 전주에서 별거 중인 아내를 흉기로 살해한 70대는 스토킹과 가정폭력으로 접근·연락금지 명령이 내려진 상태였고, 숨진 아내는 앞서 8차례나 경찰에 신고해 도움을 요청했던 것으로 15일 드러났다. 이처럼 경찰이 위험 신호를 파악하고도 참극을 막지 못한 흉악범죄가 잇따르고 있다. 최근 1주일 사이 5건이나 발생했다. 12일 제주에서는 지난해부터 스토킹과 성폭력 등을 4차례 신고한 40대 여성이 과거 연인이었던 60대 남성에게 살해됐다. 피해 여성은 당시 경찰에 구조요청을 할 수 있는 스마트워치를 차고 있었지만 가해자가 뜯어내 사용하지 못했다. 같은 날 서귀포에서는 이혼 소송 중인 아내와 양육권 분쟁을 벌이던 40대 남성이 4세 딸과 함께 숨진 채 발견됐다. 아내는 열흘 전 “딸이 위험하다”고 알렸지만, 경찰은 112로 정식 접수된...

items.title: “전자발찌, 가해자가 피해자 접근하면 자동으로 경찰에 경보 울리게 해야”
items.snippet: 경찰은 최근 수년간 가정폭력·교제폭력·스토킹 등 ‘관계성 범죄’가 강력 범죄로 번지는 것을 막기 위해 각종 대책을 내놨다. 하지만 최근 1주일 새 잇따른 흉악 범죄에서는 기존 대책의 허점이 고스란히 드러났다는 지적이 나온다. 피해자가 여러 차례 경찰에 신고했는데도 위험 신호를 제대로 포착하지 못했고, 스마트워치나 전자발찌 등 보호 장치가 있었는데도 범행을 막지 못했기 때문이다.

items.title: 검찰미래위 조사단 “위례 비리 수사, 위법성 없었다” 결론
items.snippet: 과거 검찰의 수사권 남용 의혹을 조사 중인 검찰인권존중미래위원회(검찰미래위) 진상조사단이 15일 이재명 대통령이 기소된 위례 신도시 개발 비리와 서해 공무원 피격, 문재인 정부 부동산 통계 조작 등 3건에 대한 검찰 수사에는 문제가 없었다고 결론 내렸다. 하지만 검찰미래위는 조사단에 추가 조사를 요구한 것으로 확인됐다. 법조계에서는 “검찰미래위가 추가 조사를 해서라도 검찰 수사의 문제점을 찾으려는 것 같다”는 반응이 나왔다.

items.title: 시간별 투표자 수 허위 입력… 지역 선관위 25곳 추가 확인
items.snippet: 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하는 선거관리위원회 특별검사팀(특별검사 이태한)은 전국 30개 시군구 선관위에서 6·3 지방선거 당시 시간대별 투표자수를 허위로 입력한 사실을 확인했다고 15일 밝혔다. 종전 검경 합동수사본부가 확인한 5곳에 더해 전국 25곳에서 같은 문제가 드러났다는 것이다. 특검팀은 이날 지역 선관위가 특정 업체에 선거물품 보관계약 특혜를 준 정황도 포착해 압수수색에 나섰다.

items.title: “노후화 된 공업 지역… AI·로봇 산업 거점으로”
items.snippet: 서울 영등포구에는 여의도 금융가와 문래동 철공소 거리, 아파트 단지 등이 섞여 있다. 최근엔 데이터센터 건립을 둘러싼 갈등도 벌어지고 있다. 조유진(66) 영등포구청장은 지난 13일 본지 인터뷰에서 “영등포 곳곳의 낡은 공업 지역을 AI(인공지능), 로봇 산업 거점으로 바꾸겠다”고 말했다. 조 구청장은 국회의원 보좌관, 대통령비서실 행정관 출신으로 지난 6·3 영등포구청장 선거에 더불어민주당 후보로 출마해 당선됐다.

items.title: 내신 5등급제 시행되자… 특목고 자퇴생 줄었는데, 일반고는 급증
items.snippet: 지난해 특목고·자사고·영재학교의 1학년 학업 중단자(자퇴·퇴학 등)가 최근 5년 새 최저 수준으로 떨어졌다. 내신 5등급제 도입으로 성적 부담이 줄어든 데다, 학교별 특화 교육과정이 대입에서 강점이 될 것이라는 기대도 작용한 것으로 분석된다.

items.title: 7년간 치료 이겨내고… 바다로 돌아가는 붉은바다거북 ‘럭키’
items.snippet: 15일 오전 제주 서귀포시 광치기해변에서 붉은바다거북 ‘럭키’가 바다로 방류되고 있다. 럭키는 2019년 8월 제주 해변에서 그물과 낚시 도구에 걸려 상처를 입은 채 발견돼 해양 동물 전문 구조 기관인 아쿠아플라넷 제주에서 7년간 치료받은 끝에 이날 방류됐다.

items.title: 선선한 가을 날씨… 축제 즐기기 딱 좋네
items.snippet: 10월은 축제의 계절이다. 22일 경남 사천에선 ‘2026 사천 에어쇼’가 막을 올린다. 공군 특수 비행팀 ‘블랙이글스’가 곡예 비행을 선보인다. 국산 초음속 전투기 KF-21, 지대공 미사일 천궁 등 최신 무기도 볼 수 있다. 우주항공방위산업전도 함께 열린다. 행사는 25일까지다. 경북 칠곡에선 15일 ‘칠곡 낙동강 평화 축제’가 개막했다. 올해 주제는 ‘소년, 소년병이 되다’다. 군복을 입고 부교(浮橋)를 건너는 등 소년병 체험을 할 수 있다. 행사는 18일까지 이어진다.

items.title: ‘73승 名코치’의 조언 “제자리 회전이 핵심”
items.snippet: 고진영을 여자 골프 세계 1위로 만들었고, 리디아 고(뉴질랜드)와는 올림픽 금메달을 합작했다. 깊은 부진에 빠져 있던 김주형이 2년 9개월 만에 PGA(미 프로골프) 투어 우승컵을 들고 최근 아시안게임 금메달까지 거머쥔 데에도 그의 도움을 빼놓을 수 없다. 국내 최고의 골프 교습가로 꼽히는 이시우(45) 코치다.

items.snippet: 15일 서울 고덕동에 대낮부터 ‘별’들이 쏟아졌다. 이정재, 이영애, 이재, 박찬욱, 김무열 등 한류 스타를 비롯해 임권택, 박근형, 박정자, 손숙, 고은아, 유인촌, 유동근, 전인화, 박상원, 최명길, 인순이, 배창호, 김수철, 박찬호 등 문화예술계 명사 100여 명이 운집했다. 영화계 ‘큰별’이자 어른인 신영균 선생의 백수(白壽)를 축하하기 위해서다.

items.title: 방미통위, KBS 이사 2명 임명 제청… 방문진·EBS 이사도 각 2명 임명
items.snippet: 방송미디어통신위원회(방미통위)는 15일 제42차 전체 회의에서 이강덕 관훈클럽정신영기금 이사장과 장한식 전 KBS비즈니스 사장을 한국방송공사(KBS) 이사로 대통령에게 임명 제청하기로 했다. 또 오정환 전 공정언론국민연대 공동대표와 정재욱 법무법인 태원 변호사를 방송문화진흥회(방문진) 이사로, 박기완 전 KBS 원주방송국장과 조한제 전 벡스코 상임감사를 EBS 이사로 임명하기로 했다. 6명 모두 국민의힘 추천 인사다. 방미통위는 아울러 EBS 이사회가 임명 제청한 김장환 전 KBS 대구방송총국장을 EBS 감사로 임명하기로 의결했다. 방문진·EBS 이사와 EBS 감사의 임명일은 오는 19일이다.

items.title: [플라자] 서울총장포럼·관훈클럽 업무협약 체결
items.snippet: 서울총장포럼과 관훈클럽은 15일 대학 교육과 현장 저널리즘의 연계를 강화하기 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다. 이에 따라 내년부터 관훈클럽 회원들이 서울총장포럼 소속 39개 대학에서 자신의 전문 분야와 취재 경험을 살려 정규 강의나 특강을 할 수 있는 시스템이 마련된다.

items.snippet: After more than two weeks of camping in Puerta del Sol, demonstrators are battling exhaustion and the challenges of living outdoors, while solidarity keeps the protest alive and Madrid's regional government continues to call for their eviction.

items.title: 증시 대폭락에 금융당국 긴급회의…"비상대응 준비"
items.snippet: 주가지수가 15일 크게 폭락하며 유가증권시장과 코스닥시장에 동반 서킷 브레이커가 발동한 가운데 당국도 긴급 대책 마련에 나섰다.당국은 추가 충격에 대비해 '컨틴전시 플랜'(비상사태에 대응하기 위해 미리 세워두는 비상대응계획)을 신속히 가동할 수 있도록 사전 준비에 착수하기로 했다.금융위원회는 이날 금융감독원과 한국거래소 등 유관기관, 시장 전문가들을 소집해 이억원 금융위원장 주재로 '증시상황 긴급 점검회의'를 개최했다.최근 대외 불확실성 확대로 국내 증시와 외국인·기관투자자 수급의 변동성이 심해진 만큼 향후 대응 방향을 논의하기

items.title: [우리 아기가 태어났어요] 이은빈·홍지명 아들 이준 외
items.snippet: 온 가족에게 기쁨을 안겨 준 아기의 탄생을 알려주세요. 홈페이지 주소 입력창에 아가야안녕.com이라고 입력하면 됩니다. 매일유업 육아 정보 사이트 매일아이(maeili.com)를 통해서도 접속할 수 있습니다. 추첨을 통해 출산 소식과 사진이 지면에 실린 가족에게는 ①케이크 구매권 ②엄마와 아이를 위한 매일두 포인트 3만원 ③출산 소식을 생일 날짜 본지 1면에 담은 PDF 파일 ④조선일보 1개월 무료 구독권을 드립니다. 당첨자 중 한 가족을 선정하여 해당 지면을 고급 프레임에 담아 제공하는 조선일보 리프린트도 제작해 드립니다. 홈페이지에서는 균형 영양식 메디웰 2만원 할인 혜택도 드리고 있습니다.

items.title: 직원 지방 이사에… 재택근무 허용하고 현지 사무실 마련했죠
items.snippet: 한 살 아이를 키우는 김승희 화정엔지니어링 경영기획부 과장은 지난 4월 1년간의 육아휴직을 마치고 복직했다. 복직과 동시에 육아기 근로시간 단축을 신청했지만, 아이가 자주 아파 출근하기 어려운 날도 있었다. 그럴 때마다 회사는 재택근무를 허용했다. 김 과장은 “단축 근무 중에도 아이가 아프면 흔쾌히 재택근무를 허용해줘 육아와 일을 병행하는 데 큰 도움이 됐다”고 했다. 휴직 전 맡았던 업무도 그대로 이어가고 있다.

items.snippet: 조선일보에 실린 아기 출생 소식, 본인이나 지인의 인터뷰·사진 기사를 영원히 추억으로 간직하세요. 조선일보는 독자가 원하는 신문 지면을 그대로 고급 액자에 담아 드리는 ‘조선일보 리프린트’ 서비스를 합니다. 매주 ‘아이가 행복입니다’ 지면에 소개된 한 가족을 추첨해 리프린트를 선물로 드립니다. 지난 2일 ‘우리 아기가 태어났어요’ 코너에 실린 김태리 양이 이번 주 주인공입니다. 자세한 내용은 홈페이지(reprint.chosun.com)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

items.snippet: 가상자산 과세를 2년 늦추는 법안이 여당에서도 처음으로 발의됐습니다.오늘(15일) 가상자산업계에 따르면 더불어민주당 박민규 의원은 가상자산소득 과세 시행일을 내년에서 사실상 2029년으로 늦추는 취지의 법안을 대표 발의했습니다.박 의원이 발의한 소득세법 일부개정법률안은 국가 간 가상자산 거래정보가 최초로 교환된 연도로부터 2년 뒤 1월 1일로 변경하는 내용입니다.경제협력개발기구(OECD)의 암호화자산 자동정보교환체계(CARF)에 따라 국가 간 가상자산 거래정보 교환이 내년으로 예정된 상황입니다.개정안은 "가상자산 과세를 위한 거래정보 확보와 과세 인프라 구축이 충분하지 않은 상황에서 제도를 시행하면 과세 실효성이 떨어지..

items.title: Robust Data-Driven Controller Synthesis from Sampled and Uncertain Frequency Response Estimates using Integral Quadratic Constraints
items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel MIMO controller synthesis method that relies solely on frequency-domain data of discrete-time systems. The approach is based on an iterative design procedure using \emph{integral quadratic constraints} (IQCs). It generalizes existing data-driven methods that approximate semi-infinite IQC conditions by enforcing them on a finite set of measured frequency points. Such approximations do not provide guarantees on the continuous frequency axis and may fail to capture inter-frequency behavior. We address this limitation by formulating a convex optimization problem that preserves robustness guarantees over the entire frequency range. In particular, the proposed method explicitly accounts for inter-frequency behavior of both plant and controller, leading to certified robust stability and performance. items.title: The Reciprocal tau-Cell: A Log-Domain Circuit for On-Chip Learning
items.abstract: Training hardware by gradient descent requires a gradient to be computed using a separate backwards pass. If a circuit is reciprocal, meaning every connection is symmetric, the backward pass is the same network run a second time with the error as its input. The reciprocal tau-cell, a weak-inversion log-domain circuit, makes this practical in standard CMOS. Each cell is a current-mode leaky integrator with a built-in ReLU; each connection is two transistors whose signed strength is a ratio of bias currents. The equilibrium of the network is the solution to a convex program, and latching the cells that are off will hardware linearise the circuit, making its second run exactly linear. Transistor-level SKY130 simulations show that the second run gives the gradient within 1.9%; that hardware linearisation permits large, noise-robust error signals; that a 13-cell network learns the Iris data s...

items.title: On-sky performance and prospects of near-infrared CMOS detectors in exoplanet detection: first year of SPIRIT
items.abstract: Ultracool dwarfs are promising targets for detecting and characterising temperate terrestrial exoplanets. Their flux peaks in the near-infrared, beyond the wavelength cut-off of the silicon-based CCDs used by ground-based surveys dedicated to observing them, such as SPECULOOS. We present the on-sky performance of SPIRIT (SPeculoos InfraRed Imager for Transits), an InGaAs CMOS detector on the Callisto telescope at the SPECULOOS Southern Observatory, during its first year of operation, from mid-2022 to 2023. We use 328 visits of 73 targets to optimise our CMOS-specific reduction process, including our approach to glow effects and bad-pixel handling. We find the measured precision to be consistent with our theoretical noise model, achieving sub-part-per-thousand precision under good observing conditions across targets spanning $J$-band magnitudes of 10--13. items.title: CAFE: Conducting-Cell-Aware Adaptive Differential Encoding for Robust DNN Inference in FeFET-Based Compute-in-Memory
items.abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET)-based compute-in-memory (CIM) promises energy-efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference, but device variation can severely degrade bit-sliced CIM accuracy. Prior works either rely on hardware modifications or treat such variation as generic noise, overlooking a key FeFET asymmetry: negligible off-state leakage makes errors dominated by conducting on-state cells. This asymmetry is amplified by two's-complement sign extension, which maps small negative values to high-significance bit slices and magnifies their errors during shift-and-add reconstruction. In this paper, we propose CAFE, a conducting-cell-aware adaptive differential encoding framework built upon this FeFET-specific asymmetry. items.title: Pressure engineering of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape and exciton-charge interplay in semiconductor moiré superlattices
items.abstract: Semiconductor moiré superlattices, owing to strongly bound excitons and pronounced electronic correlation, have emerged as an intriguing solid platform for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena, where the moiré potential landscape plays a central role. Hydrostatic pressure allows continuous, in-situ tuning of this landscape, but remains underexplored because of experimental challenges. Here we integrate a diamond anvil pressure cell with high quality dual gated WSe2/WS2 twisted bilayers and perform cryogenic optical spectroscopy. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moiré intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. items.abstract: We propose CktHGVAE, a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder for transistor-level analog/mixedsignal CMOS circuits that takes not only design variables but also state variables as its inputs and outputs. With a single hyperparameter configuration without topology-specific tuning, comparison between model-generated and SPICE-simulated circuit operational states gives median R2 values above 0.9 for typical single-ended voltage amplifiers and the CMOS inverter, and 0.81-0.96 for differential amplifiers with larger datasets. items.title: Pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures (Habilitation thesis)
items.abstract: Tracing my scientific path from many-body physics in semiconductor nanostructures to topological quantum matter, this Habilitation à diriger des recherches (HDR) memoir presents only part of my research since defending two PhD theses in Toulouse and Nizhny Novgorod in 2011. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists. The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. items.abstract: Strong coupling between mobile charge carriers or excitons and lattice vibrations gives rise to polarons: quasiparticles formed by charge carriers dressed by a cloud of phonon excitations. Polaron formation determines transport properties of systems ranging from transition-metal oxides and organic semiconductors to light-harvesting complexes. In excitonic systems that admit a hard-core boson description, mapping the excitations to pseudospins provides a natural framework for studying polaron physics, including the nonperturbative regime in which hopping amplitudes, phonon energies, and coupling strengths are comparable. Here, we propose a trapped-ion blueprint for realizing spin-phonon Hamiltonians with programmable spatial coupling between excitation density and phonon displacements, encompassing local Holstein and long-range Fröhlich-type interactions. items.title: Single anyons and anyon binding in a quantum Hall dot
items.abstract: Anyons are particles with quantized fractional statistics. In theory, a single anyon can be stabilized as a localized fractional charge within the bulk of a topologically ordered two-dimensional insulator. However, experiments to date have focused on probing anyons in structures in which many anyonic excitations coexist and interact. Here, we demonstrate the trapping of a single anyon in a device consisting of a graphene-based quantum point contact with an embedded tunable quantum Hall dot. Benchmarking our device at v = 1, we demonstrate backscattering between Fermi liquid edge states mediated by the whole-electron Coulomb blockade of the dot. The cleanliness and control available in our device allow depletion of the dot to the last quasihole, and we observe spin blockade for transitions to the opposite-spin Landau level. items.abstract: Mixed-anion semiconductors offer opportunities for bandgap engineering beyond conventional multication alloys, but competing phases and disorder complicate their synthesis and the identification of their electronic properties. Gallium oxynitride (GaON) could connect the technologically important GaN and Ga2O3 systems, yet establishing a clear relation between its crystal structure, composition and bandgap remains challenging. Here we report the direct growth of crystalline spinel gamma-GaON films by nitrogen-plasma-assisted pulsed-laser deposition. Varying the nitrogen and oxygen supply yields monoclinic beta-Ga2O3, predominantly disordered films and crystalline spinel GaON. Complementary diffraction, atomic-resolution microscopy and elemental analysis establish the spinel structure and nitrogen incorporation. items.title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. items.title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
items.abstract: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. items.title: Thermal stability and structural ordering of thick Co$_2$MnAl films grown on MgO and Si substrates
items.abstract: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. items.title: ARES: a plane-wave density-functional-theory code in Rust
items.abstract: ARES (Ab initio atomic mateRial modEling Software at JLU) is a plane-wave density-functional-theory (DFT) code written entirely in Rust as a layered 22-crate workspace. It supports norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method with the local-density approximation (LDA) and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functionals, Γ-only and explicit k-point sampling, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, densities of states (DOS) and dispersion corrections; execution is serial or MPI-distributed over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. The code's distinguishing engineering choice is its validation apparatus. items.title: Theory of deeply subwavelength electromagnetic structuring of semiconductors due to thermal-ionization instability
items.abstract: We develop a theory of ionization-assisted instability that governs the reflection of intense electromagnetic pulses from a semiconductor surface. Local overheating of the material increases the free-carrier density and conductivity, which in turn enhances the absorption of the incident radiation and further amplifies local heating and avalanche ionization. At high pump repetition rates, the overheating accumulates from pulse to pulse, leading to a gradual rise of the local material temperature and free carrier density - a positive feedback loop that drives thermal runaway. However, this effect competes with diffraction of the pump field on the emerging perturbation of the dielectric permittivity or on the surface relief, which reduces the local electric field amplitude in the overheated regions, thus providing negative feedback. items.title: Mixed Precision Scaling Laws for Quantized Pretraining
items.abstract: Since scaling laws were introduced for modern LLMs (Kaplan et al., 2020), several works have extended them to account for quantization, tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on AI accelerators. We develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes, grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. Our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency, and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. To select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law, we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components, isolating those that most affect loss. items.title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
items.abstract: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. We calculated pair-creation energies of approximately 12.2, 6.5, 7.3, 3.10, and 16.7 eV/pair for AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2, respectively. items.title: Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design
items.abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. items.title: The Era of Vibe Tapeout: Dark Age or Golden Age for Analog Circuit Design?
items.abstract: LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. items.title: Localized Joule heating and carbonization process optimization of 3D printed polymer structures for lab-on-CMOS applications
items.abstract: Use of carbon electrodes integrated with CMOS technology has great promise for lab-on-chip, biomedical, environmental, and industrial applications. One method of developing carbon electrodes is to 3D print polymer nanostructures on a CMOS chip, and use a thermal annealing process to pyrolyze them into carbon at high temperature, approximately 950 °C. Such high temperature is detrimental to the CMOS sensor circuits, causing severe degradation. We present a novel solution of localized Joule heating of these polymer nanostructures to achieve complete carbonization of the electrodes. Both analytical and COMSOL simulations guided the experiments to characterize the carbonization process conditions. Partial carbonization was achieved at 500-600 °C of global temperature, and complete carbonization was achieved by localized Joule heating. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. items.title: Enhancing Quasi-Two-Dimensional Electronic Structure in Bi2O2Se via Chlorine Substitution
items.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. items.abstract: A Muon Collider is one of the most attractive routes to multi-TeV lepton collisions, but it requires the accelerator and detector communities to solve a tightly coupled set of problems that have no close precedent in an operating collider. Muons must be produced, captured, cooled, accelerated, and collided before they decay. The detector must then extract clean physics from an environment dominated by decay products from the beamline. Artificial intelligence is not a substitute for accelerator physics, detector design, or engineering validation. It is, however, unusually well matched to several of the central obstacles: high-dimensional design spaces, expensive simulations, coupled subsystem trade-offs, and workflows that are currently too slow or too fragile to support broad design exploration. items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. items.title: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
items.abstract: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior. In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. items.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. items.title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
items.abstract: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. items.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
items.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. items.title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
items.abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. In a separate high-field-calibrated benchmark, RK removes 66.8% of the orbital error of a pure two-dimensional Coulomb reference, making the remaining state-selective deviations particularly informative. items.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. items.abstract: The semiconductor workforce shortage has renewed interest in making chip design accessible to students without conventional very-large-scale integration (VLSI) training. We present the AI Hardware Design League (AI-HDL), an international, project-based competition in which students use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and iteratively refine Verilog while simulation, synthesis, timing analysis, security review, and physical verification provide the engineering feedback needed to validate the result. Across two annual cycles, AI-HDL grew from 172 to 604 participants and from 40 to 108 teams, reaching 30 universities, six community colleges, and 19 countries. In the 2026 cohort, 68.7% of participants reported no prior Verilog experience. Twenty-two teams completed the four design phases and reached final evaluation. items.abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. items.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

ATLAS: Adaptive TDA-guided Landscape-Aware Transistor Sizing
items.abstract: Analog transistor sizing, finding design parameters that simultaneously satisfy multiple performance specifications, is a labor-intensive bottleneck in circuit design. To support analog circuit experts, various automation methods have been proposed, including Bayesian optimization (BO), reinforcement learning (RL), and others. Yet existing methods are oblivious to the topological structure of a feasible design space, which can fragment into disconnected regions due to operating-regime transitions, conflicting specification trade-offs, and nonconvex device physics. This topological blindness causes the optimizer to converge within a single feasible region while missing others that may contain superior designs. items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. items.abstract: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. items.title: Hall conductance of dilute electrolytes from odd stochastic density functional theory
items.abstract: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. However, existing theories fail to quantitatively account for their measured Hall conductivities. To make progress toward such a theory, we develop a stochastic density functional framework for electrolytes in a magnetic field. This framework, which we dub odd SDFT, extends the celebrated stochastic density functional theory (SDFT) to incorporate transverse mobilities and chiral time-correlated noise. Using this framework, we calculate the Hall conductivity in the absence of hydrodynamic solvent effects through three approaches: (i) direct response, (ii) Green-Kubo relation, and (iii) a hybrid fluctuation-dissipation relation. We further show that odd SDFT applies more broadly to fluids with broken time-reversal and mirror symmetry, including odd-diffusive fluids and chiral act...

items.title: Vacancy aggregation enhances NV- spin coherence in diamond: a cluster-correlation-expansion study of multi-vacancy spin baths in semiconductors
items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV-decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. First-principles theory of phonon renormalization from nonlinear electron-phonon interactions
items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions renormalize phonon frequencies and lifetimes and are central to the dynamical properties of solids. While these effects are usually described within linear electron-phonon coupling, the role of nonlinear electron-phonon interactions for phonon properties remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study phonon renormalization arising from the long-range linear one-electron-one-phonon and the nonlinear one-electron-two-phonon interactions within a diagrammatic framework. We derive the corresponding self-energy diagrams, which depend on the chemical potential and temperature, and evaluate them from first principles for the two polar semiconductors LiF and KTaO$_3$. In both materials, the two interaction channels renormalize the phonon spectrum in qualitatively distinct ways. items.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
items.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of...

items.title: Optically Coupled Noise Spectroscopy Quantifies Defect Passivation in Monolayer MoS2 FETs
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers are promising materials for electronic and photonic applications, yet the performance of chemical vapour deposition grown samples is severely limited by native sulphur vacancies that introduce mid-gap trap states, degrade carrier mobility, and elevate electrical noise. Here we investigate octanethiol passivation of sulphur vacancies in monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors, combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy. Thiol treatment reduces the sulphur vacancy concentration from 7% to 4%, reducing the free electron density. Electrically, it increases the device resistance 35-fold while restoring gate switching with an on/off ratio of 10^4 and improving field-effect mobility from 1 to 5 cm^2/Vs. Low frequency noise spectrosc...

items.title: On-chip nanoplasma for adaptive electromagnetic protection
items.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor diodes have served as the primary switching elements in adaptive electromagnetic (EM) protection, yet their performance has been compromised by parasitic effects and thermal accumulation, rendering them inadequate against the rapidly evolving landscape of high-power microwave (HPM) threats. Here we show that on-chip nanoplasma switches (NPMS), composed of gallium nitride electrodes on silicon carbide substrates, exhibit superior radio frequency (RF) and thermal characteristics, positioning them as ideal field-driven switches in RF front-end protectors. By integrating NPMS into metasurfaces, antennas and circuit limiters, we achieve an adaptive response that ensures low-loss transmission for normal signals and high shielding against HPMs, while offering extended operating bandwidth and substantially higher tolerance than conventional solid-state devices...

items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. These states show that the non-Ohmic response emerges from voltage-driven percolation. Conduction is governed by how junctions are conne...

items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structure...

items.title: Nanoscopic Multiplexing Optical Data Storage via Chip Fabrication
items.abstract: The accelerating growth of global data demands storage technologies combining high capacity, long lifetime and low energy consumption. Optical storage is attractive for archival applications, but conventional optical writing is constrained by diffraction-limited resolution and scalability, while thermal accumulation limits high-speed writing. Here we shift optical data writing from a serial optical process to a fabrication-defined process, in which lithographic masks govern where material modification occurs. Using patterned resist masks and ion implantation, we create fluorescent information voxels with nanoscale control over millimeter-scale areas. The platform supports multilevel and multidimensional encoding by independently encoding information in fluorescence intensity and wavelength. items.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. All transport results are expressed as effective thermal conductivities ($κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$) for NW devices with a finite channel length of $L=10$ nm. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models. items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. Specifically, the framework identifies compact backbones via Neural Architecture Search (AutoFormer), reduces information processing via token merging (ToMe), and accelerates per-operation execution via fp1...

items.title: Proximitized Topological Insulator Charge Island Fabricated via In Situ Multi-Angle Stencil Lithography
items.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing.
